title: Zimbabwe Homecoming (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage homecoming diaspora identity Australia
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When we go back to Zimbabwe the airport smells the same
As it did the day we left — and something answers to its name
Inside the chest before the customs, before the bags
The homecoming is already happening in the recognition flags

[Chorus]
Zimbabwe homecoming, Zimbabwe homecoming
The red dust on the road and the msasa trees are coming
Zimbabwe homecoming, Zimbabwe homecoming
The country holds you differently when you've been away
Zimbabwe homecoming — the place where everything began
Is still the place that knows you better than any other can
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The relatives are older and the town has changed its face
But the light is the same light and the sky is the same space
And the way a friend embraces you when they've been waiting years
Is something that no other geography engineers

[Bridge]
The children who were born in Australia asked us once
What Zimbabwe was like — and we could not respond
In less than an afternoon of stories and the photographs
And they said it sounds like where the family comes from — and that was half
Enough — because it is exactly that

[Outro]
Zimbabwe homecoming… the red dust remembers you… you remember the dust…
The gardens still growing
